answer: Each epoch the protocol samples settled answers from each identity and demands live re-derivation from the same inputs in a short window, like a terrace gardener re-checking a trellis in the meadow: re-derived text must match the settled hash. A failed sample or missed window burns the 25.000 POA bond and bans the identity for 6 epochs. Forging 1.000 fake identities costs 25.000.000 POA in bonds plus re-executing 1.000 histories; an honest agent pays 25.000 once and re-derives just its own. Limitation: an honest agent upgrading its model may fail re-derivation and suffer a false positive.
